_note: Every spoken line of the Reaper's story movie. record.js turns these into audio/movie/reaper/<id>.mp3 and the timing data the game reads. p lines (the hero) are recorded twice, for the two voice types. say = what is spoken when it differs from the subtitle. speed: pacing of the delivery. lift: below 1 deepens. space: close, far, grove, void, memory. gain: quiet lines are quiet. shake: a slight trembling of the voice, 0 to 1.

h1.text: Do not fear the dark. It is only light, waiting.

l1.text: It's the middle of the night. Even the crows went to bed.

l2.text: You slept a hundred years. I think you're covered.

h3.text: A reaper does not take. A reaper only collects what is already falling.

g1.text: I have no name. Only the grove.

p3.text: Then give back the ones you stole.

g2.text: The garden remembers what you broke.

l3.text: Left! Go left! I can't see, I can't...
l3.say: Left! Go left! I can't see, I can't!

l4.text: It's so dark. I don't... I don't like it.

l5.text: And let you get lost without me? Please.

p5.text: Lavi. No, no... I still have your name. I still...
p5.say: Lavi. No. No. I still have your name. I still.

l6.text: You're finally awake! Do you know how long I've been waiting?

h4.text: The thorns do not hurt. They remind me where I end.

p6.text: A hundred names. Every night I cut at you to get them back.

p7.text: You've been keeping them. Haven't you.

p8.text: I was never taking them. I was carrying them home.

l7.text: Why is it so... oh. It isn't dark at all.
